book.name: Tutui Masososaꞌ
book.title: Tutui Masososaꞌ Mulai neme Manetualain adu lalai no dae-bafoꞌ a

content: Yusuf nafada tou manahukuꞌ dua mei-afe nara sosoan

Nai uma huhukuꞌ ria, hapu lahenda dua. Fai a ulu na, dua si dadi malaka malalau nai mane Masir uma manaparetan. Esa urus maneꞌ a nininu na. Esa bali urus maneꞌ a roti na. Dua si tao rasalaꞌ maneꞌ a. Huu ria na maneꞌ a namanasa, de tee si leo uma huhukuꞌ daleꞌ reu. De dua si mamanaꞌ esa ro Yusuf.
Basa de, malaka bui ria pareta Yusuf fo urus pegawe sira. Ara leo rai naa losa teuꞌ esa-dua rian so.
Hatuꞌ esa, boe ma pegawe sira dua ralamei. Esaꞌko noꞌ mei-afen. Ma mei-afes sira esaꞌko sosoan.
Balahaꞌ boe ma, Yusuf mai te nita dua si mata-idu nara ta raleleka fa.
Ana natane si nae, “Ubeaꞌ taon de faiꞌ ia emi dua mata-idu mara ta ralelekaꞌ fa?”

Ara rataa rae, “Leodaeꞌ a ami malamei, tehuu ami ta bubuluꞌ sosoa-raraan ubeaꞌ.” Basa de Yusuf dedea nae, “Ta hapu lahenda esa nalelaꞌ mei-afes ara sosoa-raraan, adaꞌ noi Manetualain riꞌ bubuluꞌ. Soba emi tui dei. Neuꞌ ko au saka sudi sosoa-raraa nara neme Manetualain mai.”
Basa ria, boe ma pegawe fo urus maneꞌ a nininu na, tui nae, “Leo iaꞌ! Au alamei, ita ai anggor huuꞌ esa
baꞌeꞌ telu. Aihuu ria nadoo tutiꞌ a, nabuna, ma naboa rakikii, latu-latuꞌ mesan.
Basa de au ita, au homu maneꞌ a galaas nininu na. Boe ma au etu a anggor ria boa na, de hee oe na neuꞌ maneꞌ a galaas na daleꞌ. Basa de, au loon leo maneꞌ a neu, fo ninu.”
Yusuf namanene leoꞌ na, boe ma nafada nae, “Papa. Meis ria sosoa na leo iaꞌ: Baꞌe sira telu, nana sosoa na faiꞌ telu.
Nai fai kateluꞌ ia ra dalen, neuꞌ ko maneꞌ a poꞌi na papa nemeꞌ uma huhukuꞌ ia mai. Basa nate ana soꞌu na seluꞌ papa, fo urus seluꞌ maneꞌ a nininu na, sama leoꞌ maulu na.
Maneniko papa ua-nalem malole a leoꞌ na, sona bosoꞌ mafarene heni au, o! Maneniko papa sue au, sona tui maneꞌ a ela ana poꞌi au emeꞌ mamanaꞌ ia mai boe.

Tuka matetu na, maulu na ara hai au no nasetiꞌ eme lahenda Ibrani ra koro na, de roo au leo iaꞌ mai. Nai ia boe au ta tao salaꞌ hata esa boeꞌ. Tehuu kekeneu te, ara ena au nai uma huhukuꞌ ia, sama leoꞌ au ia lahenda tadaluꞌ.”
Pegawe fo urus maneꞌ a roti na namanene mei-afes ria sosoa na malole a leoꞌ naa, boe ma ana tui Yusuf nae, “Fadi, e! Au boe alamei leo iaꞌ: au sua atutuleꞌ lapaneu telu.
Nai lapaneu misilai teteꞌeꞌ a, hapu maneꞌ a kokis rupa nara rai daleꞌ. Tehuu manupuiꞌ ara mai, de raa heni kokis sira nai au laka ka lain.”
Yusuf namanene leoꞌ na boe ma, nataa nae, “Papa mei-afes ma sosoa na leo iaꞌ: lapaneu sira telu, sosoa na nae faiꞌ telu.
Nai fai kateluꞌ ia ra dalen, neuꞌ ko maneꞌ a nadenu lahenda mai tete heni papa laka ma. Basa te, ara londa nenetu ma neuꞌ dii lain. Boe ma manupui ara mai raa heni papa popora ma.”
Basa faiꞌ telu, naraa laꞌe maneꞌ a fai boboki na, ana tao feta bauinaꞌ fee basa pegawe nara. Ana pareta fo reu poꞌi ra pegawe sira dua reme uma huhukuꞌ daleꞌ mai.
Basa de, maneꞌ a soꞌu na seluꞌ pegawe fo urus nininu na neuꞌ nonoi laka maulu na, de ana urus seluꞌ maneꞌ a nininu na.
Boe ma pegawe fo urus maneꞌ a roti na, ara londa raisan, natetu no Yusuf dedea na.
Tehuu pegawe fo urus maneꞌ a nininu na, ta nafarene Yusuf soꞌ.
